Subject: Purge request for AUR-563 - prompts/outputs/logs

Hi Olga,

Per our conversation with your CS team last week, Aurora Health is requesting a full purge of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and associated inference logs for tenant AUR-563 (production workspace: aur-563-prod). We need: 

- Confirmation of exact objects that will be removed (prompts, assistant outputs, KV cache, request traces).
- A timeline for execution (we prefer a target window of May 3–4, ET).
- An artifact proving deletion (manifests, checksums, and timestamps) for our records and auditors.

Attached is a scope CSV with customer-facing IDs. If you need the legal PO or an exec OK, Contracts is copied.

We'd like the purge to include any ephemeral conversational caches and any saved prompt-output logs older than 30 days for this tenant. Please confirm next steps and who will be the technical owner.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Director, Data Governance
Aurora Health

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear scope and the CSV. We've pulled your file into the intake queue.

Quick answers up front:
- Owner: priyom_das (Platform Ops) will own execution and will provide the deletion manifest.
- What we'll remove: prompt inputs, model outputs, request-level traces, KV cache shards tied to the workspace ID list in your CSV. We will not touch archived backups outside the tenant scope unless explicitly listed.
- Timeline: Can commit to start purge work on Fri 2029-05-03 02:00 PT and complete by Fri 2029-05-03 12:00 PT (same-day window). If you need Eastern times, that's 05:00–15:00 ET.

Action items for us:
1) Intake verification (done) — internal ticket created RB-98721.
2) Pre-run snapshot & redaction staging (will take ~45–60m).
3) Purge run (automated agents + manual verification) — target 8–10 tokens of parallelism per shard.
4) Post-run proofs: a signed manifest (hashes + timestamps), a short runbook excerpt, and a per-object deletion confirmation file.

I've attached a preliminary manifest template and flagged Contracts in case a DPA addendum is needed for the official audit trail. Please confirm the earliest time you can accept the final proof bundle; we'll plan delivery to the Drive link below and to the email address you confirm.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Emma / Olga —

We executed the scheduled purge window this morning. Summary: 

- Start: 2029-05-03T09:02:18Z (coordinated stop-the-world snapshot)
- Completion: 2029-05-03T11:41:09Z
- Objects removed: 7,412 prompt-input rows, 7,412 output blobs, 3,200 request traces, 12 KV cache shards matching aur-563-prod prefixes.

Proof artifacts delivered: 
- purge-manifest-20290503.json (manifest: list of deleted object ids, UTC timestamps, SHA256 per object)
- deletion-log-20290503.txt (high-level run log)
- proof-bundle-AUR-563.tar.gz.md5 (checksum file; we do not attach archives over email)

Delivery: All artifacts uploaded to your Drive folder and to a secure S3 build of our evidence bucket. Drive link provided above; S3 location: s3://redwood-erase-proofs/AUR-563/20290503/ (read-only, pre-authenticated link will be shared to the Aurora admin address).

Notes and caveats: 
- Backups: we did not remove cold backups stored under cross-tenant archival keys. Those are governed by our retention policy and require a separate signed request.
- Audit hashes: SHA256 computed and signed by our purge agent version v2.3.1; signature file included in the bundle.
- Rollback: This operation is irreversible for the objects listed in the manifest.

If you want a DocuSign-ready attestation, we can prepare a short certificate of destruction and route to Contracts.

Regards,
Priyom Das
